title: Some stream and login requests answer 500 during an outage, against the docs' 'wait rather than answer an error'
notes: Subtitle requests (internal/api/subtitles.go:72, 246, 336, 457) call s.Items.Source without db.Retry, and DELETE Videos/ActiveEncodings calls Transcode.Stop (internal/transcode/jobs.go:243-249) without it. A request that passed requireAuth just before the outage began, or a PlaybackInfo-style call in that window, gets 500 'internal error'. Login (POST Users/AuthenticateByName, internal/api/users.g Promoted to JS-146.
